item.title: Sotto 0.3.6
item.description:
• Developer mode gains a live Log. Open Developer (⌘7) and the Log tab shows what Sotto is doing as it happens: search it (⌘F), filter by category, level and time, click a line to see its details, and copy lines for a bug report. It shows only what macOS keeps in Sotto's own log, never your words, and it only reads while the tab is open.
  • Sotto's log categories now match the Log's filters (dictation, notes, orb, updates, yesterday, history, app). If you search the log yourself, the per-dictation timing line is under dictation now.

sha256 9edf7e7d989fa353c12654fa613003c1d40bd05a033ebdcb0c5d7655ed8bb86b

item.title: Sotto 0.3.5
item.description:
• Yesterday has a new layout: a one-line headline, then Worked on, Still open, and By app. Open an app to see just its own lines from that day, with a link to those dictations in History. Every line comes from what you said; if Sotto can't write a summary it trusts, it shows the day's numbers instead.
  • Spoken snippets: in the Dictionary pane, add a phrase like "my calendar link" and the text it stands for. Say the phrase in any dictation and the text lands exactly as you wrote it, line breaks included (as spaces in a terminal). Snippets are plain text files you can edit anywhere.
  • Dictionary words now match even when a comma or dash lands in the middle ("fleet, view" becomes FleetView).
  • The Yesterday page is never blank: it says when it's still reading, and if your History can't be read right now it says so, with Try Again.
  • Only one copy of Sotto runs at a time, so two copies can't lock each other out of your History.
  • Starting a dictation just after a note that saved nothing no longer closes the pill while you talk.

sha256 05dfbbfb44f0fcfd9c4809ca85d208b3a77d39a81e24317bd31e7b0076d22333

item.title: Sotto 0.3.4
item.description:
• The Dictionary now lives in the Sotto window as its own pane (⌘6), with undo and search. Edits in progress are kept when you switch panes or quit.
  • Developer mode: turn it on in Settings › About. It adds a Developer pane (⌘7) with Status (speech engine, cleanup model, app version, input device, theme, last press and permissions) and Switches (update badge style, and eval export, which only works while Developer mode is on).
  • Logs no longer include error descriptions in plain text.

sha256 3fa08fa92f39107dfec7ad21b61b748d9cd7d6a443ccde3c0751a6378ade4fcd

item.title: Sotto 0.3.3
item.description:
• Tidy Note: a note that was left as spoken can be tidied again from the reader. If a note wasn't tidied, the reason is saved with it, and writing the result won't overwrite edits you made in the meantime.
  • Yesterday: the day stepper is now borderless, and ⌘[ and ⌘] move between days. Each app's recap has a "Show these in History" link.
  • Yesterday now summarises every part of a long app's day, not just the start, and accepts more technical days instead of refusing them. If the day recap is refused, the app recaps are still shown.
  • Notes: no stray "˜" when you stop with ⌥Space. If no audio arrives within 2 seconds of Resume, Sotto says so. If the mic dies mid-segment, the audio so far is kept.

sha256 28c432403b5b46d674d41b174f53b8b6a3939ec333a9f7b0ee9b0778c15d0bc1

item.title: Sotto 0.3.2
item.description:
• The Insights window is now the Sotto window (Open Sotto in the menu). Its panes are in a new order: Yesterday, Notes, History, Stats (was Overview) and Voice Profile.
  • Yesterday: a short summary of your last day of dictation, app by app, written on your Mac by the local model and never typed anywhere. Step back through earlier days with ‹ ›. The first time you open Sotto each day, it opens on Yesterday.
  • Settings › History is now Settings › Data, and Reset Insights is now Reset Stats.
  • The orb now always appears in the Sotto theme, even over a text field; Classic keeps the capsule.

sha256 9c92d976bfe593163ca4c0fc790c8d28a03f4a3d9a7c4a0d6c4d6cf4bdc64ab3

item.title: Sotto 0.3.1
item.description:
• Voice notes: while holding ⌥Space, tap N to turn what you're saying into a note. Let go and Sotto keeps listening, hands-free, with Pause and Stop right on the pill; ⌥Space again saves it. Notes are tidied by the on-device model and kept as Markdown files on your Mac. Nothing is typed and nothing touches your clipboard.
  • The orb takes notes: it looks down at a small notepad while you talk.
  • A new Notes pane in Insights, and a Notes item in the menu, to read, copy and move notes to the Trash. A note is never lost if Sotto quits or your Mac sleeps mid-note.
  • The orb ripples the pill whenever it leaves or returns, and pops up from, and drops back into, the bottom of the screen.
  • The Note key can be changed in Settings › General.

sha256 6b662c13b4b1ef05339acf10167a687589f7b491dcffe93d2822de130e62cd65

item.title: Sotto 0.3.0
item.description:
• A new indicator: a glass orb above a slim pill. It appears, listens, tidies and drops back into the pill. With Reduce Motion on, it just fades.
  • Insights keeps its counts when History is off or cleared; History controls only your words. Reset Insights… in Settings › History starts the counts over.
  • Sotto checks for updates every hour and when your Mac wakes. The menu bar icon shows a mark when one is ready, and the menu shows your version with Update to the new version underneath. Check automatically in Settings › About turns this off.

sha256 af717f6a8715f17b7430ebbf685fbe7ce496d98535609dc860cc7314a0fd7f05

item.title: Sotto 0.2.9
item.description:
• When an update is waiting, an exclamation mark appears beside the menu bar icon and the menu offers Update to the new version.
  • Clear History… sits at the top of the History list, so there's no scrolling to reach it.

sha256 10399a2c3e21eaf79596e5108108517f3d0335cf46c6bed1da4a8a92ca375f69

item.title: Sotto 0.2.8
item.description:
• Settings, Insights and the Dictionary always open in front of you, on the screen you're using.

sha256 d5cad22a28cd69ca205142788156a33ba236136f53ccdee315c0a3aa787091b9

item.title: Sotto 0.2.7
item.description:
• Long dictations land faster, up to about twice as fast for a paragraph.

sha256 9581fae48303b36579b22b76f484e2c86ef56caaf7c2e7628652668ae1e0b3da

item.title: Sotto 0.2.6
item.description:
• Your voice profile now shows a sentence length histogram; compile again to see it.

sha256 555a3bb612e5161bc75a267e36469ecbced20e87449082e96431cecc24f1fe17

item.title: Sotto 0.2.5
item.description:
• Updated the on-device language model runtime (llama.cpp); no change to your text.
  • Compiling your voice profile is now one click: no quote review, no confirmation. Delete a dictation from History to keep it out.
  • The voice profile now keeps only what you control by speaking: punctuation figures like exclamation marks, dashes and emoji are gone.

sha256 d4ec366e6bbc768f25f57444206b8a784c529ac834bfb00f54651072761332cd

item.title: Sotto 0.2.4
item.description:
• Dictating right after you edit your dictionary no longer comes out uncleaned.

sha256 9c0783e47ec18dd80fbe1093af37b53c1d082f7ffa1db2d37737b3af6c531628

item.title: Sotto 0.2.3
item.description:
• New Settings › Appearance › Show live words switch: turn it off and the speech bubble never appears, and Sotto doesn't work out live words at all.
  • The figure now wakes up: the first dictation after Pause starts with its eyes closed and opens them as it settles.
  • The figure has a few expressions now: it blinks at a pause, glances up while cleaning up, squints when text lands, and looks puzzled or shrugs when something goes wrong, and looks away when you say "scratch that". Choose Appearance › Classic to turn it off.
  • You can compile a voice profile after 50 dictations; it's marked early until you reach 200.
  • You can see your voice profile in Insights: a summary, your sentence lengths and punctuation, and the samples in the file, with Copy and Compile Again in the toolbar.
  • Your voice profile now lives in Sotto's own folder (~/Library/Application Support/Sotto) instead of Documents, so iCloud Drive no longer syncs it. An existing profile is moved over once; use Copy to paste it, or Reveal in Finder to find the file.

sha256 89e1e61b67c400fa7bb7bf410328f9f23f42d4c353f30cf6c45cebffc6888b91

item.title: Sotto 0.2.2
item.description:
• The indicator (capsule, head, shoulders and speech bubble) now follows the system appearance instead of taking its light or dark look from what's behind it.
  • Sotto's dictation engine is now open source: https://github.com/sidbhargava1/sotto-engine
  • The personal dictionary has its own window: open Personal Dictionary from the menu or Settings → Dictation to see every term, search, add, edit and delete, with Undo. Adding a term that's already there merges what Sotto hears for it.
  • The dictionary is still the same text file, and anything you wrote in it by hand, including comments, is kept. Open in Editor at the bottom of the list opens it.
  • Dictionary rows show a pencil and a trash can when you point at them or select them, to edit or delete a term.
  • Adding or editing a dictionary term now has Save and Cancel buttons; Return and Esc still work.
  • The speech bubble now floats a little higher above the head, so your words don't crowd it.
  • If the speech model hasn't finished downloading, the capsule now says "Speech model not downloaded" instead of a generic error.

sha256 cf5915617632a27f1a9b378b6f9bc7bd41753075b9342d9e08d659638e4363fa

item.title: Sotto 0.2.1
item.description:
• Fixed a crash when dictating into one of Sotto's own windows, such as the Try it step in setup.
  • A Bluetooth mic that keeps dropping its connection no longer makes Sotto restart the microphone over and over: after a few tries it switches to another mic, such as your Mac's built-in one, and Settings says so. Choose it in Settings, reconnect it, or relaunch Sotto to try it again.
  • When the microphone sends no audio at all, the capsule now says "No audio from" and names the device, instead of "Didn't catch that".
  • The Clean Up Text switch has left the menu: turn cleanup off in Settings → Dictation by choosing None. If you had it off, that's already set.
  • The menu is tidier: Insights, Personal Dictionary and Settings have icons, and menu items no longer end in "…".

sha256 681beee68ed4e3fb6c096e80b9d286d004a9ac18fbbac2d824bf10967aebfebe

item.title: Sotto 0.2.0
item.description:
• A face while you speak: a small glass figure rises from the capsule and shows your words in a speech bubble as you say them. Choose Classic in Settings → Appearance for the plain capsule, or pick a hairstyle.
  • History, only if you want it: an opt-in record of your dictations, kept in one file on this Mac, excluded from backups, deletable in one click. Off until you say Keep.
  • Insights: how much you dictate, how fast you speak, how long words take to land, and which apps they went to. Search everything you've said.
  • Voice profile: after enough dictations, compile a short file describing how you write, for pasting into Claude or Copilot. You review every quote.
  • Settings is organised into panes: General, Dictation, Appearance, History, Permissions, About. The menu is shorter.
  • Bluetooth microphones (AirPods) work: the mic stays warm so the first words aren't lost. Your headphones play at call quality while Sotto runs with them as the input.
  • Terminals: dictating into iTerm2's hotkey window is treated as a terminal, so nothing can execute. Multi-line dictations land on one line.
  • Names you add to the dictionary are corrected before cleanup, including multi-word heard-as spellings.
  • The glass surfaces have an edge so they read over any desktop, and the capsule shows a ring of light while listening.

sha256 db665251153ec1ac20132092ee9573201118f42b8adf2feb575f72d6f45ae4d0

item.title: Sotto 0.1.1
item.description:
• Sotto now updates itself: it checks once a day and offers new versions, or choose Check for Updates… in the menu.
  • Updates keep the Accessibility permission and the downloaded cleanup model.
  • "Scratch that" matches more loosely, and spoken lists are typed as real lists.

sha256 64788d1b72af52521e85cd81fca1f3e456d888177007ed18a5f7b06a82865d6f
